opb. Approximately 50% is reabsorbed, mostly in the proximal convoluted tubule.
opc. Approximately 50% is reabsorbed, mostly in the distal convoluted tubule.
opd. Less than 20% is reabsorbed, mostly in the collecting duct.
ope. It is almost 100% reabsorbed, mostly in the proximal convoluted tubule.
